dropzones.name: Oradea (Aeroclubul Teritorial "Smaranda Brăescu")
dropzones.status_evidence: The club commander said in a 6 Nov 2022 report that the club has had no runway since 2012 and does its practical parachuting at Arad. A dated 1 Feb 2025 article repeats that Oradea has had no suitable flying field since 2012, with only theory taught locally and the jumps made at Arad. The 30 Dec 2025 national notice leaves Oradea out of the 2026 parachuting locations. This is positive evidence that jumping stopped, not just a lack of evidence. A TripAdvisor listing for 'Ultimate High' in Oradea offering tandems could not be opened (HTTP 403) and has no dated activity, so it does not change the verdict.
